newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan industry employment up 0.1 pct-IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan industry employment up 0.1 pct-IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian January industrial employment rose 0.1 percent from December, but fell 6.5 percent in comparison with January last year, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
Industrial employment in the 12 months to the end of January also decreased, down 10.7 percent, the IBGE said.

The IBGE said January employment levels increased most in Sao Paulo state, up 0.4 percent from December, followed by Minas Gerais state, up 0.3 percent. Rio de Janeiro and the Northeast were the only areas to see a fall in industrial employment, down 0.9 percent each.
The largest employment gains were in the tobacco industry, up 23.5 percent from December; furniture, up 2.8 percent; and electric and communications materials, up 2.8 percent, the IBGE said.
Total salaries paid in January increased 0.9 percent from December but fell 5.9 percent from January 1996.
The total number of hours paid decreased 1.5 percent from November to December, the IBGE said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
